text:
miriam: Quick sync — product wants to ship the routing MVP in this quarter. Proposed MVP: latency-tier routing + prefix cache; no re-ranking, no private deploy. Can runtime/infra/security commit to sequencing and dates?
raj: runtime note — basic routing is doable but we need 3w for kernel tweaks + 1w perf validation. If we cut re-ranking that's fine.
casey: infra needs autoscale config + 2x GPUS for canary capacity. Also need VPC CIDR for the canary cluster. ETA depends on ticket priority ~2w after ticket.
dana: security: hosted-only MVP reduces compliance scope. We'll still need a short threat model doc, SSO gating, and audit logs enabled. Can sign off faster if MVP is hosted-only and we skip data export features.
oli: platform: rollout and feature-flagging work is small. I can own canary/flag but need the rollout criteria (error/latency thresholds) and a short runbook. ~5 business days.
miriam: OK — suggestion: narrow to hosted-only MVP and remove re-ranking and private deploy from scope to hit timeline. Agree? Who else blocks?
raj: hosted-only is fine. We need an explicit fallback to a smaller model if latency SLOs break — otherwise tail latency risk. I'll add that to perf plan.
casey: hosted-only reduces infra change surface, but we still need capacity reservation for canary. I can open INFRA ticket and request 2 gpus for the canary pool.
dana: hosted-only still needs KMS + audit logging. If you can produce a 1-pager threat model, security can review within 3 business days.
miriam: I'll update the PRD to the narrowed scope (hosted-only, no re-ranking, rollout flags, perf fallback). Action owners: @oli rollout config, @raj perf tests & fallback, @casey infra ticket & capacity, @dana security review.
oli: I'll add the feature flag + canary plan to the ops repo and link it in the PRD.
raj: Creating perf runbook + scheduling QA perf runs. Will post results in this thread.
casey: INFRA-3124 opened for canary capacity, assigned to eng-infra.
deploy-bot: INFRA-3124 created by casey and assigned to eng-infra.
miriam: Thanks all — I'll post final PRD update and milestone dates by EOD. :thumbsup:
